tagline: Amakuru yihuse kandi asobanutse yo gufata ibyemezo by'ibiribwa

status.noneVerified: Nta soko ry'amakuru yemejwe rirahuzwa. Amakuru yose muri iyi demo ni ay'icyitegererezo kandi arabigaragaza.

welcome.title: Amakuru Asanzwe y'Ibiribwa, Umusaruro n'Isoko mu Rwanda
welcome.intro: AgrIntel ihuza amakuru y'ikirere, ubutaka, umusaruro n'ibiciro byo ku masoko mu Rwanda hose. Ifasha abahinzi, abacuruzi, ingo z'abaturage, n'abayobozi gufata ibyemezo bikwiye kandi byihuse.
welcome.disclaimer: Ibyavuye mu isesengura ni ibigereranyo bifasha gufata ibyemezo. Ntabwo ari icyizere cyuzuye cyangwa inama za politiki.

welcomeHub.title: Amakuru Asanzwe y'Ibiribwa, Umusaruro n'Isoko kuri Buri Munyarwanda
welcomeHub.intro: AgrIntel ihuriza hamwe amakuru y'umusaruro yizewe, ibiciro byo ku masoko, n'imvura igwa kugira ngo ibyemezo by'ubuhinzi n'ibiribwa byorohere buri wese.

whatWeDo.title: Icyo Dukora
whatWeDo.desc: Dukusanya amakuru yemewe y'ubuhinzi, ibiciro by'ibiribwa ku masoko yo mu turere 30, n'ingano y'imvura kugira ngo hatagira umuntu ugenda mu bwijima.

whatValueWeBring.title: Akamaro Tubazaniye
whatValueWeBring.desc: Dufasha umuhinzi kumenya igihe cyo kugurisha adahombye, tugafasha umushoferi kumenya isoko rifite inyungu, tugafasha imiryango guhaha neza bahendukiwe, no gufasha abayobozi kumenya aho amapfa ari hakiri kare.

whatToDo.title: Icyo Ugomba Gukora
whatToDo.subtitle: Hitamo icyiciro urimo munsi uhite ubona amakuru n'inama bikubereye:

farmer.action: Menya igihe cyo kugurisha cyangwa kubika, tegera amatwi inama mu Kinyarwanda, kandi urebe ibiciro by'aho utuye.

retailer.action: Bara igiciro cya mazutu y'ikamyo, wirinde kwangirika kw'imyaka mu nzira, kandi umenye umujyi ufite inyungu isumbye iyindi.

leader.action: Kurikirana umusaruro mu turere 30 twose, menya aho imvura yabuze, kandi umenye neza ko imbuto n'ifumbire byatanze umusaruro witezwe.

citizen.action: Kurikirana ibiciro by'ibiribwa mu ntara yawe, ukoreshe igatebo y'ibiribwa y'ikoranabuhanga uhitemo ibihendutse bifite intungamubiri.

national.title: Incamake y'igihugu
national.body: Ibimenyetso by'ibyago ku bijyanye no kubona ibiribwa mu turere, hamwe n'amasoko n'amatariki.

market.title: Ibiciro ku masoko
market.body: Imigendekere y'ibiciro by'inyanya n'ibirayi, ibihe by'iteganyagihe bigaragazwa.

retailer.title: Itangwa ry'abacuruzi
retailer.body: Gereranya uturere dutanga umusaruro n'aho ugurishirizwa.

farmer.title: Inama ku bahinzi
farmer.body: Imiterere y'aho uri n'inama rusange, hamwe no kugenzura n'inzobere aho bikenewe.

farmerHero.title: Ubufasha bw'Ibanze ku Bahinzi
farmerHero.subtitle: Byateguriwe abaturage n'abahinzi: amafoto manini, inama isomwa mu majwi, n'ikimenyetso cyoroshye cyo kugurisha cyangwa kubika.

radar.title: Kugenzura Umusaruro mu Turere 30 Twose
radar.desc: Kureba niba buri karere katanze umusaruro witezwe, no gutandukanya amapfa n'ikibazo cy'imbuto cyangwa ifumbire mbi.

arbitrage.title: Imibare y'Ubwikorezi n'Igiciro cya Mazutu
arbitrage.desc: Kubara igiciro cya mazutu y'ikamyo n'ibyangirika mu nzira, hagamijwe kumenya niba kujyana umusaruro mu mujyi bifite inyungu.

inflation.title: Igatebo y'Ibiribwa ku Miryango yo mu Rwanda
inflation.desc: Gufasha ingo kumenya ikiguzi cy'ibiribwa bya buri kwezi no kubaha ibiribwa bihendutse bifite intungamubiri zihwanye.

market.title: Ibiciro ku masoko
market.intro: Ibiciro by'impuzandengo ya buri kwezi ku masoko akurikiranwa. Ibyabonetse n'iteganyagihe ryemejwe bigaragazwa ukwabyo.
market.trendHelp: Igereranya amezi 3 aheruka n'amezi 3 abanza. Bisaba nibura amezi 6 y'ibiciro byabonetse.
market.chartCaption: Umurongo ukomeye: ibyabonetse buri kwezi. Umurongo uciye: iteganyagihe ryemejwe, niryaboneka. Igicucu: urwego rw'iteganyagihe.
market.chartAria: Igishushanyo cy'ibiciro by'impuzandengo ya buri kwezi, ibyabonetse n'iteganyagihe
market.tableCaption: Ibipimo buri kwezi mu buryo bw'imbonerahamwe
market.noForecast: Nta teganyagihe ryemejwe rirahari kuri iki gihingwa. Igishushanyo cyerekana ibiciro byabonetse gusa.
market.uncertainty: Ibiciro bihinduka bitewe n'ikirere, umusaruro n'ubwikorezi. Fata icyerekezo nk'igereranyo gifite urwego, si igiciro cyizewe.
market.influenceTitle: Ibishobora kugira ingaruka kuri iki cyerekezo
market.influenceNone: Ibimenyetso by'itangwa n'ikirere by'iki gihingwa ntibirahuzwa, nta ngaruka zigaragazwa.
market.noData: Nta makuru y'ibiciro yemejwe kuri iki gihingwa kurahari.
market.insufficient: Nta mezi ahagije y'ibiciro byabonetse yo gusobanura imigendekere.
market.sampleNotice: Bimwe mu bigaragara kuri iyi paji ni amakuru y'icyitegererezo yo kwerekana. Ntabwo ari ibiciro by'ukuri.

macroCpi.title: Ibiciro by'Ibiribwa mu Mijyi no mu Byaro
macroCpi.divergenceExplanation: Ibiciro by'ibiribwa birahanitse mu cyaro ugereranyije no mu Mujyi wa Kigali. Ikiguzi cy'ingendo n'ubwikorezi, amasoko make, no kubura aho guhunika bituma ibiciro mu cyaro bizamuka cyane, bikagaragaza akamaro k'ubwikorezi buhendutse n'ubuhunikiro bw'uturere.

smartBasket.title: Igatebo y'Ibiribwa n'Uburyo bwo Kuzigama
smartBasket.intro: Ibiciro by'ibiribwa byazamutse mu Rwanda. Andika umubare w'abantu bagize umuryango wawe urebe ikiguzi cy'ibiribwa by'ukwezi, kandi uhitemo ibindi biribwa bihendutse bifite intungamubiri zihagije zo kugufasha kuzigama.
smartBasket.withSubstitutions: ugendeye ku guhitamo ibiribwa bihendutse bifite intungamubiri
smartBasket.substitutionsSubtitle: Bona intungamubiri zihwanye neza uzigama amafaranga:

national.title: Icyerekezo cy'igihugu ku kubona ibiribwa
national.intro: Ibimenyetso by'ibiciro ku masoko ku turere ku gihingwa cyose, hamwe n'isoko, itariki n'ibimenyetso by'ikimenyetso cyose. Uturere tutagira amakuru yemejwe twerekanwa nk'ibitaboneka aho kugereranywa.
national.scopeNote: Iki ni ikimenyetso cy'ibiciro ku masoko gusa. Ibimenyetso by'ikirere, ubutaka n'umusaruro ntibirahuzwa, ntibigaragara hano.
national.ruleText: Impuzandengo y'ibiciro by'amezi 3 yabonetse aheruka igereranywa n'amezi 3 yabonetse abanza. Izamuka rya 10% cyangwa arenga ni kiciriritse; izamuka rya 20% cyangwa arenga ni gikomeye. Indi mpinduka yose ni gito. Itegeko ryitegereza amezi 9 aheruka. Akarere gakeneye nibura amezi 6 y'ibiciro byabonetse muri iyo myaka, kandi igiciro cyaheruka ntikirenze amezi 4. Amakuru ashaje ntiyigera atanga ikimenyetso.

evidence.title: Ibimenyetso by'akarere
evidence.select: Hitamo akarere mu mbonerahamwe kugira ngo urebe ibimenyetso by'ikimenyetso cyako.
evidence.noSignal: Nta kimenyetso cy'isoko kuri aka karere n'iki gihingwa kirahari. Nta mateka ahagije y'ibiciro yemejwe.
evidence.riseText: Impuzandengo y'ibiciro by'amezi 3 aheruka iri hejuru ya {percent} ugereranyije n'amezi 3 abanza.
evidence.fallText: Impuzandengo y'ibiciro by'amezi 3 aheruka iri munsi ya {percent} ugereranyije n'amezi 3 abanza.
evidence.flatText: Impuzandengo y'ibiciro by'amezi 3 aheruka ingana na mbere y'amezi 3 abanza.
evidence.uncertainty: Iki kimenyetso gisobanura ibiciro ku masoko gusa. Ntabwo ari iteganyagihe ry'umusaruro cyangwa icyizere cy'ibiciro bizaza.
evidence.responseNote: Nta gisubizo gitangwa mu buryo bwikora. Igisubizo cyose gisaba kugenzurwa n'inzobere mbere yo gusangizwa.

audit.title: Isuzuma ry'Umusaruro n'Ifumbire mu Turere
audit.intro: Ubugenzuzi bugereranya umusaruro w'uturere n'uwari witezwe, hagamijwe gutandukanya niba umusaruro muke watewe n'izuba cyangwa niba byatewe n'imbuto n'ifumbire bitanoze.
audit.leakageCount: Uturere Tufite Umusaruro uri Hasi y'Uwari Witezwe

districtMatrix.title: Imiterere y'Umusaruro mu Turere 30 Twose
districtMatrix.subtitle: Reba uko umusaruro wifashe muri buri karere ko mu Rwanda. Hitamo kureba ahakeneye ubufasha, ahabuze imvura, cyangwa ahatanzwe umusaruro uhebuje.

decisions.title: Ibikorwa By'ibanze Bikenewe Uyu Munsi
decisions.subtitle: Ibyemezo n'ingamba zikenewe mu turere:
decisions.urgentAuditContext: Abahinzi bakoresheje imbuto n'ifumbire byinshi, ariko umusaruro waguye hasi cyane. Bikeneye kugenzura ubuziranenge bw'imbuto no kureba uko ifumbire yagejejwe ku baturage.
decisions.benchmarkContext: Umusaruro mwiza cyane waturutse ku guhuza imbuto z'indobanure, ifumbire nziza, n'amaterasi arwanya isuri. Urugero rwiza ku turere duturanye.
decisions.climateContext: Umusaruro wagabanutse bitewe n'imvura nkeya. Icyambere ni ugushyira imbaraga mu kuhira no gutwikira ubutaka.

advisory.title: Inama ku bahinzi n'abakozi b'ubuhinzi
advisory.intro: Imiterere y'isoko ry'aho uri, icyerekezo cy'ibiciro mu gihugu n'inama rusange ku karere n'igihingwa kimwe. Amakuru y'ikirere, ubutaka n'amatungo ntiyarahuzwa, aya ntabwo agereranywa.

weather.title: Ikirere
weather.body: Amakuru y'imvura n'ubushyuhe ntiarahuzwa kuri aka karere.

soil.title: Ubutaka
soil.body: Nta bipimo by'ubutaka byemejwe biraboneka kuri aka karere.

livestock.title: Ibiryo, amazi n'amata
livestock.body: Nta makuru y'amatungo yemejwe araboneka kuri aka karere.

agronomic.title: Incamake y'Umusaruro n'Umuhingire mu Karere
agronomic.leakageAdvice: Umusaruro wabaye mucye cyane mu gihe ifumbire n'imbuto byaguzwe ari byinshi. Buri gihe jya ureba ikimenyetso cyemewe cya RAB ku mifuka y'imbuto kandi wirinde kugura ifumbire n'imbuto bifunguye mu buryo butizewe.
agronomic.climateTitle: Inama mu Gihe cy'Izuba n'Imvura Nke
agronomic.climateAdvice: Ibihingwa muri aka gace byagizweho ingaruka n'imvura nke. Aho bishoboka, vomerera imyaka ukoresheje imigezi yo mu bishanga, shyira ibyatsi byumye ku butaka kugira ngo amazi adakama, kandi uhinge ibihingwa bidasarurirwa icyarimwe.
agronomic.intensificationAdvice: Abahinzi bageze ku musaruro mwinshi kubera gukoresha neza imbuto z'indobanure, ifumbire ikwiye, n'amaterasi. Wibuke kwanika neza umusaruro mbere yo kuwuhunika kugira ngo utabora.
agronomic.nominalAdvice: Umusaruro n'ikoreshwa ry'ifumbire biri ku kigero cyiza cyari cyitezwe. Komeza amabwiriza meza y'umuhingire kandi ugurishe binyuze muri koperative kugira ngo ubone igiciro cyiza.
agronomic.noData: Nta makuru y'ibarura ry'ubuhinzi yanditswe kuri iki gihingwa muri aka karere.
agronomic.samplingWeightsNote: Bishingiye ku ibarura ry'ubuhinzi rya NISR rikorwa mu gihugu hose

outlook.title: Icyerekezo cy'ibiciro mu gihugu
outlook.note: Iki cyerekezo kireba impuzandengo y'igihugu ku masoko akurikiranwa, si akarere kawe.
outlook.none: Nta cyerekezo cyemejwe kiraboneka kuri iki gihingwa.

guidance.title: Inama rusange
guidance.note: Ni amakuru rusange gusa. Ugomba kugisha inama inzobere mbere yo gukurikiza inama iyo ari yo yose.
guidance.high: Ibiciro by'iki gihingwa byazamutse cyane vuba aha mu karere kawe. Gereranya ibiciro by'abaguzi barenze umwe mbere yo kugurisha cyangwa kugura byinshi.
guidance.moderate: Ibiciro by'iki gihingwa byazamutse vuba aha mu karere kawe. Reba ibiciro by'aho uri buri gihe kandi utegure kugurisha ukoresheje amakuru agezweho.
guidance.low: Ibiciro by'iki gihingwa bihagaze cyangwa biragabanuka mu karere kawe. Nta nteguza y'ibiciro ihari ubu.
guidance.unavailable: Nta mateka ahagije y'ibiciro yemejwe kuri aka karere kugeza ubu. Baza ibiro by'abakozi b'ubuhinzi by'aho uri amakuru agezweho.
guidance.livestock: Amakuru y'ikirere, ibiryo n'amata y'inka z'amata ntiarahuzwa. Ku biryo, amazi n'ubuzima bw'amatungo, baza umuganga w'amatungo cyangwa umukozi w'ubuhinzi wo hafi.

action.sellAdvice: Ibiciro by'iki gihingwa mu karere kawe byazamutse cyane (+{percent}). Ni umwanya mwiza wo gusarura no kugurisha kugira ngo winjize inyungu nziza.

action.consultAdvice: Nta makuru ahagije y'isoko yemejwe kuri iki gihingwa muri aka karere kugeza ubu. Gisha inama agronome w'umurenge cyangwa koperative yanyu.

cropCards.subtitle: Kanda ku ifoto y'igihingwa wifuza kureba ibiciro n'inama mu majwi

dairy.dsiDescription: Gusuzuma niba hari ubwatsi n'amazi bihagije ku nka z'amata mu turere tw'aborozi mu Rwanda.

dairy.actionGuidance: Inama ku borozi: Bika ubwatsi bwa Napier hakiri kare, koresha ibisigazwa by'imyaka byongerewemo ifumbire ya yureya, kandi utwikire ibibumbiro by'amazi.

retailer.intro: Gereranya ibiciro ku murima n'ibiciro ku masoko yo mu mijyi, ubare amavuta y'ikamyo n'ibyangirika mu nzira.
retailer.readOnly: Ni icyerekezo cyo gusoma gusa. Nta makuru y'abahinzi, abacuruzi cyangwa abavugana yo kugaragaza.

decisions.title: Ibyemezo Bikenewe Uyu Munsi
decisions.subtitle: Kugena uburyo bwoherezwa umusaruro w'amakoperatiba n'ububiko bwo mu byaro:
decisions.topSpreadContext: Inyungu isigaye irenze 40 Rwf/kg nyuma yo gukuramo lisansi n'ibyangirika. Kohereza umusaruro w'umurengera ako kanya ku masoko y'umujyi.
decisions.vulnerableFuelContext: Inzira ndende ifite inyungu yoroshye. Yahita igwa mu gihombo niba nkunganire ya lisansi ivuyeho cyangwa imodoka idapakiye yuzuye.
decisions.localAbsorptionContext: Kohereza mu mujyi bitanga igihombo kubera ikiguzi cy'ubwikorezi. Guhunika umusaruro mu bigega by'amakoperatiba mu karere.

outlook.none: Nta cyerekezo cyemejwe kiraboneka kuri iki gihingwa kugeza ubu.

howToRead.title: Uko iyi mbonerahamwe isomwa
howToRead.body: Inkingi z'ibiciro ziva ku biciro byemejwe by'uturere. Inkingi z'itangwa n'aho ibicuruzwa bikurwa zikomeza kugaragara nk'ibitaboneka kugeza igihe amakuru y'umusaruro yemejwe ahujwe. Ntabwo hagaragazwa ibirenze cyangwa ibibura, kuko amakuru atarabishyigikira. Inzira ntizitegurwa, kuko amakuru y'ubwikorezi ntayo.

arbitrage.title: Ibarura ry'Inyungu n'Igiciro cya Mazutu ku Masoko
arbitrage.intro: Ribarura inyungu isigara hagati y'igiciro cyo ku murima n'icyo ku isoko rya Kigali n'andi masoko, rikuramo amavuta ya mazutu n'ibyangirika mu nzira.
arbitrage.sliderHelp: Hindura igiciro cya litiro ya mazutu urebe uko inyungu y'ubucuruzi ihinduka:

howToRead.title: Uko Ubwikorezi n'Inyungu Bibarwa
howToRead.body: Kuri buri nzira, ubwikorezi bwa kamyo y'amatoni 5 bubarirwa (2 * intera * 0.32 L/km * Igiciro cya Mazutu) / 5,000 kg + amafaranga yo gupakira. Inyungu ikuramo ibyangirika mu nzira (urugero: 8% kuri buri km 100 ku nyanya, 1.5% ku birayi, 0.5% ku binyampeke). Inzira itanga hejuru ya 40 Rwf/kg ikwiye koherezwaho umusaruro; iri munsi ya 10 Rwf/kg ikwiye kugurishwa hafi.

alerts.title: Ibiburira n'icyigana
alerts.intro: Ibiburira bibwira abahinzi, abakozi b'ubuhinzi n'abasesenguzi igihe hari ikintu gikeneye kwitabwaho. Ubu buri nteguza iri hano ni icyigana cyo kwerekana. Nta butumwa bujya kuri telefoni iyo ari yo yose.
alerts.empty: Nta biburira birahari. Kora icyigana kiri hepfo urebe uko biburira bikorwa.

simulation.title: Gerageza ivugurura ry'amakuru
simulation.description: Yongeraho ikosora ry'icyitegererezo ry'igiciro ku karere kamwe no ku gihingwa kimwe, hanyuma akerekana buri ntambwe: kwakira ivugurura, kugenzura, icyerekezo cy'isoko n'igishushanyo cy'iburira.
simulation.guarantee: Impapuro rusange ntizihinduka. Ivugurura rigumana gutegereza kugeza risuzumwe rigemewe, kandi nta butumwa bwoherezwa.

details.validatedPending: Ryatsinze ibipimo. Ritegereje gusuzumwa, ntirikoreshwa mu makuru rusange.
details.validationFailed: Ryanze ibipimo. Ivugurura ryanzwe kandi nta kindi cyakozwe.
details.previewed: Ikimenyetso cy'isoko cyahinduka kiva kuri {before} kijya kuri {after} (impinduka {beforePct} ikajya {afterPct}). Ni icyerekezo gusa.

simulation.explanationTemplate: Icyigana {id}: ikosora ry'igiciro ryigana ku kwezi kwa vuba. Ibimenyetso rusange bigumaho kugeza ivugurura risuzumwe rigemewe.
simulation.sourceNote: Amakuru y'icyigana. Ntabwo ari imibare ya leta. Ntiriboherejwe.

methodology.title: Amakuru y'ibanze n'uburyo bwakoreshejwe
methodology.intro: Aho buri mubare kuri uru rubuga uturuka, uko ukorwa, ukuri kwawo mu mateka, n'ibyo utakubwira kugeza ubu.
methodology.sourcesNote: Buri soko ryanditswe hamwe n'imiterere yaryo yo kwemezwa. Isoko rikoreshwa mu makuru rusange gusa iyo ryemejwe.
methodology.lineageNote: Buri kuvana amakuru ni dosiye cyangwa urubuga rwanditswe, rugenzurwa kandi rusuzumwa mbere y'uko agaciro kayo kagaragara. Checksum igaragaza dosiye nyayo yakoreshejwe.
methodology.noImports: Nta makuru yinjiye yanditswe kugeza ubu. Shyiramo amakuru y'icyitegererezo urebe amateka.

mathSection.title: Imibare n'Ibyagendeweho Bifasha Abaturage
mathSection.subtitle: Buri mubarire yose ikurikiza imibare ifatika kandi yoroheje ishingiye ku musaruro w'abahinzi, ibiciro by'amasoko ya buri munsi, na mazutu ya kamyo:

forecast.title: Icyerekezo cy'ibiciro
forecast.horizonValue: Kugeza ku mezi 6 imbere, uhereye ku kwezi kheruka kwemejwe
forecast.intervalValue: Hafi 80%, ruvuye ku makosa y'uburyo ku mateka
forecast.note: Ni icyerekezo fatizo, si icyizere cy'ubuhanga bwo guhanura. Ukuri gutangazwa gusa biva ku bigeragezo bifatika byakozwe hepfo.

risk.title: Ikimenyetso cy'isoko ry'akarere
risk.note: Gikubiyemo ibiciro ku masoko gusa. Ibimenyetso by'ikirere, ubutaka n'umusaruro ntibirahuzwa.

auditMethod.title: Igenzura ry'Umusaruro w'Ibihingwa n'Ifumbire mu Turere
auditMethod.model: Uburyo bwo Kubara Umusaruro Witezwe: Imvura, Imbuto nziza n'Ifumbire
auditMethod.formula: Umusaruro Witezwe = Impuzandengo y'akarere x Imvura n'Ubushyuhe x Imbuto n'Ifumbire byakoreshejwe
auditMethod.residual: Itandukaniro ry'Umusaruro = Umusaruro wabonetse gukuramo Umusaruro wari witezwe
auditMethod.leakage: Ikibazo cy'Imbuto cyangwa Ifumbire: Umusaruro wari munsi cyane y'uwitezwe kandi imvura yaraguye n'ifumbire yarabonetse (kugenzura imbuto z'amiganano cyangwa gutinda gutanga inyongeramusaruro)
auditMethod.climate: Ikibazo cy'Izuba n'Imvura nke: Umusaruro wabaye mucye bitewe n'amapfa cyangwa imvura nke cyane
auditMethod.intensification: Umusaruro Ushimishije: Akarere kabonye umusaruro munini cyane binyuze mu gukoresha imbuto nziza, amaterasi no kubungabunga amazi
auditMethod.sampling: Byakusanyijwe mu mabarura yemewe y'ubuhinzi akorwa mu turere twose tw'u Rwanda.

arbitrageMethod.title: Imbata yo Kubara Inyungu y'Amakamyo Atwara Ibiribwa mu Mijyi
arbitrageMethod.formula: Inyungu Isigaye kuri Kilo = Igiciro cy'isoko mu mujyi (gukuramo ibyononekaye mu nzira) gukuramo Igiciro ku muhinzi gukuramo (Lisansi ya kamyo + Umusoro w'isoko + Ibyo gupakurura)
arbitrageMethod.burnRate: Imodoka itwara toni 5 z'ibiribwa ikoresha litiro 32 za mazutu kuri buri kilometero 100
arbitrageMethod.shrinkage: Ibyangirika mu nzira: Inyanya zangirikaho 8.0%, Ibirayi 1.5%, Ibigori byumye 0.5%
arbitrageMethod.fuelPolicy: Igiciro cya mazutu mu Rwanda: 2,927 Rwf/litiro. Hatariho ubufasha bwa Leta kuri mazutu yari kuba 3,600 Rwf/litiro (kuzigama 673 Rwf kuri litiro).
arbitrageMethod.breakeven: Igiciro ntarengwa cya mazutu: Igiciro kinini umushoferi yakwishyura atarahomba ku rugendo.

methodology.accuracyNote: Amakosa aturuka ku gusubiramo uburyo ku mezi yashize, hakoreshejwe gusa amakuru yari ahari icyo gihe. Umubare muto ni mwiza. Nta gipimo cy'ukuri cyerekanwa keretse hari igeragezo ryagitanze.
methodology.noEvaluations: Nta bisubizo by'igeragezo biraboneka. Kora umuyoboro w'iteganyagihe kugira ngo ubitange.
limits: Amakuru y'ukuri akomoka mu mabarura yemewe y'ubuhinzi mu Rwanda, amakuru y'amasoko yo mu turere, inyemezabwishyu z'abahinzi, n'ibipimo by'ikirere bya Meteo Rwanda.
Icyerekezo ni impuzandengo y'igihugu ku masoko akurikiranwa. Ibiciro byo mu gitururwa cyawe bishobora gutandukana gato.
Igenzura ry'umusaruro n'ingendo z'amakamyo bitanga inama z'ingirakamaro; buri gihe banza ugishe inama agoronome cyangwa koperative mbere yo gushora amafaranga menshi.
Iteganyagihe ry'ibiciro ryerekana uko byagenze mu myaka yashize; ntabwo ryemeza 100% ibizaba mu minsi iri imbere.
Inama z'ubuhinzi zitangwa nk'ubufasha rusange; gana agoronome cyangwa muganga w'amatungo wemewe ku bijyanye n'ingano nyayo y'imiti n'ifumbire.
Buri kintu cyose kiboneka mu buryo bworoshye mu Kinyarwanda cyumvikana neza no mu Cyongereza gisobanutse.
